notes.title: CryptoClickers: Version 1.6
notes.content:
This is pretty much just a major bug fix update, and probably the last update (more information below).

Secret bitcoin code is: 111144333322 c:

[h1]CryptoClickers v1.6[/h1]
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Playfab Cloud Saving
[*] Auto Hardfork now tells you why it doesn't work (during Halvening Tutorial)
[/list]

[h2][Changed][/h2]
[list]
[*] Drones are now hidden in compact mode if you haven't unlocked them.
[/list]

[h2][Fixed][/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor UI Bugs
[*] Minor Typos (and weis and satoshis)
[*] GPU Speed Tokens overflowing
[*] Node Bugs
[*] Daily Reward giving more than it should on the 7th day
[*] Auto Speedrun settings were buggy
[*] A bunch of Micro Faucet bugs
[*] Minor achievement bugs
[*] Autobuyer Value 1.0 prevents Value 2.0 from being bought via buy max
[*] Minor Halvening bugs
[*] Minor Setting bugs
[*] Server tree can no longer be abused with import preset exploits
[*] (PC) seriously, some of y'all set the toggle settings keybind to left click... why?? It's ok. I fixed that c:
[*] Halvening tutorial no longer gets stuck!
[/list]

[h2][Removed][/h2]
[list]
[*] Daily Challenges
[*] Discord Button
[*] Leaderboard (sad)
[*] Removed the total SP display
[*] 
[/list]

I am deeply sorry this update took way longer than it should. I feel like I should address some things. CryptoClickers Meta Prestige was in the making, but Idle Research and CompactO quickly replaced it as I enjoyed working on those more. CryptoClickers is old, it's been redone twice and the code is still very bad and it's very stressful to play with. Thus, development because more of a stress and toll on my mental health, rather than an enjoyable hobby, unlike Idle Research.

My plan was to publish CompactO, update CryptoClickers, and then publish Idle Research. However, I am not going to be updating CryptoClickers in between anymore, which is why I am releasing this bug patch now. I have hidden all meta prestige content as it was not finished, not even close. I hope you all understand. Thank you to everyone who supported me along the way and supported the development of this game. I am deeply sorry for disappointing those who have been waiting for the Meta Prestige update. Will it ever be finished? I am sure at some point I will try to finish it, but I am not making any promises. I need to take care of myself and my mental health and work on things that I enjoy (Idle Research).

I am not the type of person to give up. I feel embarrassed and ashamed about having to write this, but you all deserve the honesty.

If you read all of that, you rock!

Stay tuned for Idle Research and CompactO! I think you will all love Idle Research especially :)
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/9A9CjrSxeu

[h3]
Thank you, and again I am deeply sorry,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.content:
[h1]CryptoClickers v1.5.2[/h1]
[h2]Added[/h2]

[*] Added back the play time text, this time in Settings.
[*] More speed tokens allocation sizes in Refinery.
[*] Buy Max to P0.0.1 Server Upgrade.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cleaned up Node a little for people who just unlocked it.
[*] Cleaned up the UI in general for people who are new to the game.
[*] Cleaned up Server’s preset screen.
[*] Nerfed Node’s 51% Attack Bitcoin Boost.
[*] Minor tweaks to Drone UI for less confusion.
[*] Improved Bitcoin’s initial Grand Hardfork screen to make it noticeable that you need to do Node in order to GHF.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Halvening wasn’t boosting Ethereum properly while in the Halvening Screen, screwing up the gains from run time.
[*] Refinery bugs.
[*] Auto Grand Hardfork not activating after unlocking Halvening.
[*] Event changing pop up while in event.
[*] Time Machine E’s “Ready for nothing”.
[*] Halvening Stats Screen not showing Time Machine E’s stats.
[*] Small visual bugs.
[*] Challenge 9 bugs with Auto Challenge.
[*] Old UI pop ups and [?] pop ups.
[*] Halvening Upgrades Buy Max not buying the “Gain 1.25x More Bitcoin WHILE in Halvening” upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug where Importing a code would buy more on top of what you currently have.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] More silly “satoshi” mentions...
[*] Buy Max in Server.
[/list]

Time to drink EVEN more seltzer, strawberry flavored. As always, enjoy the update! Thanks for your patience!

[h3]
Cheers,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.title: CryptoClickers: Version 1.5.1
notes.content:
[h1]CryptoClickers v1.5[/h1]
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new Halvening upgrade: “Gain 1.25x More Bitcoin WHILE in a Halvening Run for this Time Machine” to provide a better incentive to be in Halvening runs.
[*] Platonic to the Motivation Credits for Auto Challenges =)
[*] Skip button in the tutorials (come on new people stop hating on me ;-;)
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bitcoin boost is now based on your Highest Bitcoin ever.
[*] P2 was buffed to 2x more Ethereum per Server Upgrade bought.
[*] Capped the cost Micro Faucet+ Upgrade to 100 levels.
[*] Nerfed Micro Faucet+ Hardfork Stat.
[*] Buffed Micro Faucet+ XP Gains.
[*] Base Burn Duration: 10 => 30 Seconds.
[*] Changed “Grand Hardfork Booster” to “Bitcoin Gain Booster 1” in Node - Ethereum Boosters.
[*] Changed $ Shop UI.
[*] BIT Ethereum Upgrade 1 now starts off at 10 Bitcoin, so you can buy Auto Challenges!
[*] Covered the Chip upgrades so you can’t buy them while not unlocked, genius mindset.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auto Speedruns settings were not working at all.
[*] Text escaping in some areas.
[*] Some visual bugs related to Challenges not displaying the current goal before you buy Bypass Double in BIT.
[*] Buffed Bitcoin Gain Booster 1.
[*] Some other small visual bugs.
[*] Moved the Ad Popup so it’s not in the way.
[*] Bitcoin and Halvening tutorials.
[*] Where the total server upgrades bought did not reset on the Speedrun entry.
[*] Infinity visual bug for the first BIT Bitcoin Upgrade.
[*] Visual bug for Halvening ETH/s in Time Machines B+.
[*] Micro Faucets going far into the negatives.
[*] When AFK on Challenge 4, it will exit the challenge if your Claim Value is < 0.01 (uhh?)
[*] Ad Boosts now work on Friday Events.
[*] Generators and Drones can’t be bought in Challenge 14.
[*] NaN/Infinity Leaderboard Wipe phase (basically, if your Highest Ethereum is NaN, it will be gone in the leaderboards after this update!)
[*] Several Node bugs.
[*] Speedruns breaking the game with certain settings.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Calculation for how many SP spent, I could never get it correct, so for now it’s gone as it kept producing issues.
[*] The ability to have a WhiteSpace username (aka: “ “ or “     “) (seriously, you can be more creative than that!)
[/list]

Sorry for the newer players with the tough grind to getting their first Grand Hardfork! Should be a better now. Also deeply sorry for those who were effected with Halvening! Hopefully you guys enjoyed the changes as much as I did.

Time to drink more seltzer, enjoy the update!

[h3]
Cheers,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.title: CryptoClickers: Version 1.5 - Major Balancing Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317124/574b8c7dd9bf284558d2b2891966f0bb7df0532d.png[/img]

[h1]CryptoClickers v1.5[/h1]
[list]
[*] I have decided to sit down for a week and play the entire game, from 0 Ethereum to 1.00e500 Bitcoin. I am very happy with the results and glad I had the time to make all of these changes. I believe the game has a more consistent pace and it’ll help make the game less confusing and stressful in some places! Enjoy this amazing balancing update!
[*] Note: As a result of the nerfs, end game players, your Bitcoin Gain will drop significantly, this is also because Halvening was reset. Sorry! This had to be done D:
[/list]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Speedruns 2.0: Same as before except there are 20 Speedruns that each identify with a challenge. When you enter a Speedrun, you cannot enter that specific challenge (therefore you make less SP). To add more depth, you can change Tiers which increases the goal and reward substantially. Speedruns now play a major role throughout Bitcoin from unlock to end. Speed Tokens are gained passively during Speedruns.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317124/d9bb211ad7251a9a486e3c6db9ea4e222d245c5d.png[/img]
[*] Prestige to reset Coils and aETH to gain aBTC. Upgrades do not reset. This fixes all the previous Halvening Bugs as well. Most of Halvening will be reset for all players due to this new system, but hey, it’s no longer a painful grind!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317124/980cb30f538d84a78849464eb7e647e7679b935d.png[/img]
[*] Auto Challenge, along with Don’t reset Challenges (both in BIT). Auto Challenge costs 5 Bitcoin, this should be the player’s very first purchase with Bitcoin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317124/5d11af2417d2c7b7e1c047985ed2623160393ad4.png[/img]
[*] Auto Grand Hardfork, instant, found in Automation Server Tree (5e6 Auto Points).
[*] Added Auto Import Server Preset 1 after Grand Hardfork because of how the Server Tree gets all messed up after some higher Speedruns.
[*] New Upgrade in Micro Faucets.
[*] Server based Leaderboard banning, so now I can ban those pesky cheaters (or people that somehow bugged out of existence).
[*] Added an in-game pre-Bitcoin Challenge Order! Found in Challenges under “Guides.” It has a bunch of Server Tree codes that you can copy and import in “Server.” :)
[*] In Drones, you can now set a minimum drone auto buyer. No more flashy numbers in the later part of Bitcoin!
[*] 2 new IAPs for Steam (Ad Popups Free Rewards and 2x Ad Popup Frequency $4.99) (Suggested)
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Capped Achievements at 1.00e8 since there really is no point in getting more. Rewards you in more FPS.
[*] Buffed Hardfork in Micro Faucets.
[*] Changed Micro Faucets UI.
[*] Challenge Completed Notification now has a setting to turn it off and it calculates the total challenges completed and SP gained till you close the notification.
[*] Nerfed Ethereum and Bitcoin gains because of how fast progress was.
[*] Severely nerfed Grand Hardfork Ethereum Node Boost, the goal is now to get to 6 Bitcoin to promote the new Auto Challenge feature.
[*] Added unlock prices to Chips so the player can focus on the main game and getting BIT Upgrades.
[*] Coils are now much less confusing and aren’t based on time left.
[*] Tons of BIT upgrade costs have been adjusted to balancing, most of them being reduced. Scaling for the BIT Ethereum Upgrade 1 has been slowed down as well but the base cost is slightly higher (more friendly towards mid-Bitcoin).
[*] Buffed GPU, Overpowered is now 2% Overclock per level and Stress gives a 25% effect instead of 10%.
[*] Redid all of the [?] buttons with refined and shortened explanations.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashing at very specific points when Grand Hardforking or starting a Speedrun. This was caused by Buy Max, Buy Max is a split second slower now but it’s much safer.
[*] Fixed some Node bugs when really far into it.
[*] Notifications had a 0.55 second delay because of the old Halvening and Bitcoin UI, got rid of that.
[*] Navigation during Hardforks and Grand Hardforks no longer forces you to the main Ethereum screen (very annoying!)
[*] Fixed Thursday event.
[*] When leaving Bitcoin and going back, it no longer brings you back to the main Bitcoin screen (also very annoying!)
[*] Music Volume has a sharper curve, so it’s not as loud when the slider is 50%.
[*] Fixed some Tutorial flaws.
[*] Fixed Thursday's event from being too OP.
[*] Fixed some events from not working while out of the Events page.
[*] Fixed where Hacking notification showed up before you unlocked it.
[*] Fixed Dogecoin not unlocking in Bitcoin Secret.
[*] If you get more than e10 TT from events, it’s clear you were cheating, it will be forced down to e4.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Node Boost for Micro Faucets.
[*] Removed various BIT upgrades.
[*] Removed all Challenge Completion BIT Upgrades.
[/list]

Last time I said v2.0 would be the next major update, well that didn't happen! I decided to play the entire game through during Fall Break and realized the many flaws the game had. I took a lot of heart, hardwork, and time into balancing the game, fixing things up, and improving the game play in various regions of the game. Hopefully this will be the last of the final changes and I hope you guys enjoy this update! I am very sorry that Halvening resets, it had to be done );

Next Major Update: v2.0 - Third Prestige
I promise <3

[h3]
Cheers,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.title: (POLL): Challenges & Bitcoin BIT
notes.content:
Hello, I am announcing a poll, please provide your answers in the comments:

How does this sound:
Severely nerf "Grand Hardfork Booster" so you get like 5-10 Bitcoin on your first GHF. Instead of buying Challenge Completions, there are 2 upgrades: 
1. Auto Challenge, it automatically enters challenges based on the optimal challenge order in #cc-guides. It'll cost simply 1 Bitcoin (for your hard work), 
2. Don't Reset Challenges on Grand Hardfork, title says it all, cost is to be determine but I am hoping for it to be around 1e15-1e25 Bitcoin.

In the comments, post:
1 for: Yes!
2 for Too OP, nah
3 I just don't like the idea (explain why)

Results on discord as of this post is 10-0-0, I wanted to get your opinions too.

Thanks,
CryptoGrounds

notes.title: CryptoClickers v1.4 - Events & UI Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317124/f86eeaedd4c5fe8d001e2397a1e661bef1476fb9.png[/img][h1]CryptoClickers v1.4[/h1]
[list]
[*] Brand new set of hourly events, enhanced UI, bug fixing, balancing, and QoL improvements!
[/list]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] All Time Machine buttons in Halvening
[*] Colorblind numbers to the Challenge list
[*] Buy Max option for Bitcoin Chip Effect upgrades only
[*] Buy Max Power option for Bitcoin Chips.
[*] Set 100 buttons in Chips.
[*] rmbartz and Engineering Notation
[*] Buy Max in Server
[*] Added Auto Retry Challenge
[*] Added a “Term Dictionary” for new players who might get confused with some currencies.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Server has been split into two trees, production and automation. Automation upgrades require Auto Points, which are passively generated. This will reset your current tree when you update however, you will gain Auto Points on load/import once based on your server tree completion.
[*] Replaced the following events: Sunday, Saturday, Wednesday, Tuesday
[*] The Node Emergency button now splits your Ethereum and Bitcoin transactions evenly.
[*] Severely nerfed Offline and Micro Faucet Node boosts.
[*] Halvening Time Machine progress bars are now in log10 scale.
[*] Auto Refurbish now buys only 1 Chip Effect level and automatically sets usage to what it was prior to refurbishing.
[*] New color theme and enhanced the UI a lot.
[*] 3? Button now says “Coming Soon,” no more confusion!
[*] Some places were missing notation.
[*] BIT: Bitcoin Upgrades (Refinery Speed Tokens*1.05^Tokens) has been changed to (11x Refinery Speed)
[*] Secret Game mode code is now entered only on the home screen of Bitcoin.
[*] Severely nerfed Erosion offline gains.
[*] Improved tutorials.
[*] Improved daily reward pop up.
[*] Nerfed Node boosts severely.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI bugs related to the swap sides.
[*] Fixed Dogecoin button in CryptoGrounds Secret Gamemode
[*] Fixed challenge start buttons displaying the wrong “Start” and “MAX” status.
[*] Fixed Stats screen
[*] Bitcoin Home now works when in Chips
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t access Challenges during the tutorial.
[*] Replaced more “Satoshis” with “Bitcoins.”
[*] Fixed AFK mode, previously it was giving negative cooldown time and doing some other odd stuff.
[*] Fixed Micro Faucet resetting on import, again.
[*] Fixed Halvening UI issues.
[*] Prevented large Player.log files from being created.
[*] Server is no longer reset when you complete Challenge 18 manually and then perform a Grand Hardfork. Instead it buys as much as it can.
[*] [MOBILE] Fixed a bug where watching an Ad for 2x game speed hides the 2x Game Speed pop up.
[*] Fixed a Drone Tier exploit.
[*] Fixed an infinity bug for Bitcoin offline gains.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cost for Bitcoin Chip Refurbishing
[*] Stats button, wasn’t useful anyways.
[/list]

[h3]Thank you and enjoy, thanks for being patient as always. Thank you to my community, the reviews, and the r/incremental_games community for helping me find ways to improve the game for you guys!
I have had a lot of IRL stuff happen such as studying for the SAT test and getting busy with schoolwork. Hope you guys enjoy this update!

Next Major Update: v2.0 - Third Prestige

Cheers,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.title: CryptoClickers v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]CryptoClickers v1.2[/h1]
More bug fixing, Challenges and Node have been redone!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Paste button in Save Settings.
[*] Added Daily Rewards
[*] Node has been completely redone, Node 2.0 has now been added! Unfortunately progress for Node will be reset...  this is because the new node is completely different.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenge completions have been reduced a lot (30s -> 10s, some 20s -> 10s). Challenge goals are scaled as if you are completing 2-3 challenges (depending on the challenges that were reduced, same with server rewards.
[*] Confused? Just know that you will have to do a lot less challenges now, and rewards should seem easier and not repetitive to get.
[*] C8’s goal is buffed, and its reward has been nerfed. Too overpowered.
[*] Coil’s drain time was just crazy, nerfed it a ton.
[*] Reduced the costs of some Server Automation Upgrade costs.
[*] Improved the equation for Halvening Shard gains (after you get bypass infinity)
[*] Micro Faucets now cost 1e200 Bitcoin in BIT Unlockable upgrades.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed C4 from causing Infinity in Achievements.
[*] C18 and C3 should now be purchasable for all 5 completions.
[*] Challenge UI will now update on load, Grand Hardfork, and after Challenge completion.
[*] Coils and Bitcoin Micro Faucets now import.
[*] AFK mode should display days AFK (why are you AFK this long )
[*] Fixed the bug where speed tokens notification would show up if you had more than 0 but less than 1 tokens.
[*] Node Synced Data now caps at 1e1000 instead of resetting it (previously to prevent an NaN).
[*] Server button should now be intractable after your Grand Hardfork.
[*] Keybinds for generators now don’t work in C6.
[*] Fixed some Server upgrade costs.
[*] Daily Challenge notification should now bring you to the right destination! All aboard!
[*] Bitcoin Grand Hardfork screen doesn’t cover up the entire screen anymore.
[*] Hardfork stays unlocked after 1e9 Ethereum.
[*] You will now get the correct amount of IP when using Buy Max (Node was not boosting Value 1 buy max).
[*] Fixed Speedruns toggling off the Keep Server BIT Upgrade
[*] You will no longer see notifications for features that haven’t been unlocked yet.
[*] Secret game mode now imports when you import a save.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Daily Code, I kept forgetting and really, it was an unreliable system anyways. Replacing with Daily Rewards.
[*] Daily Video
[*] Old Node
[/list]

[h3]Thank you and enjoy, thanks for being patient! Sorry about Node being reset, but I definitely think this is for the better. It will make getting to 1.79e308 Ethereum much easier and it has way more boosts for Ethereum and Bitcoin than the old Node!

CryptoGrounds[/h3]

[h1]CryptoClickers v1.1[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] [MAJOR] Interactive Tutorial (WIP), only people with < 1e10 Ethereum can see this.

[*] Fixed a bug where if you had Auto Server and you Grand Hardforked, you would get more Wei after you Hardfork (you would have to have Hardfork BIT Generation Upgrade to notice).
[*] Fixed Auto Server bugs.
[*] Fixed a Node’s upgrade description being wrong when bought.
[*] Fixed numerous incorrect BIT upgrade costs.
[*] Fixed BIT Challenge Completions and other BIT upgrades displaying the wrong costs.
[*] Finally fixed Steam Achievements (hopefully).
[*] Fixed a bug where Steam says you are still playing the game even when you close (hopefully, if not, Steamworks.github.io’s fault).
[*] Halvening Time Machine doesn’t block the entire screen anymore, caused by tapping a notification while in Animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where Drones and Drone Tiers were not in sync.
[*] Challenge 15 (Dragon Scaling) no longer freezes on Buy Max.
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy,
CryptoGrounds[/h3]

notes.title: Discord Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where Discord was required to play the game.
Not sure why this happened, hopefully it works!

To get the update now:
1. Go To Task Manager
2. Select Steam Client Bootstrapper
3. End Task
Make sure steam is completely shut down
4. Load back into steam
5. Game should auto update if you have it turned on.
Now it should work even without Discord!
